title: FHFA’s Oversight of the Enterprises’ Use of Appraisal Data Before They Buy Single-Family Mortgages, AUD-2014-008
authors_or_organization: Federal Housing Finance Agency Office of Inspector General
data_collection_dates: Portal data Jan 2013-Sep 2013; fieldwork through Nov 2013
limitations: Covers the first years of the portal (pre-Collateral Underwriter, 2013 data). Counts loans that triggered warnings, not loans that were actually defective; false-positive rate of warnings unknown (the report says the Enterprises had not measured it).

title: Interagency Appraisal and Evaluation Guidelines (75 FR 77450), Section XV Reviewing Appraisals and Evaluations
authors_or_organization: OCC, Federal Reserve Board, FDIC, OTS, NCUA
limitations: Supervisory guidance: shows expected review obligations and permitted risk-based depth, not actual lender practice, compliance, review hours or detection performance. Read Section XV (pp. 77461-77463) closely; other sections skimmed.

title: An Overview of Enterprise Appraisal Waivers, WPR-2018-006
authors_or_organization: Federal Housing Finance Agency Office of Inspector General
limitations: White paper, not an audit; benefits (time, cost) are Enterprise-reported projections relayed by OIG, not OIG measurements. Redacted (an FHFA offer-rate cap is blacked out). Predates large 2020-2021 waiver expansion.

title: Loan Collateral Advisor FAQ
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Freddie Mac is the developer of the tool and the consequence-bearing purchaser (interested party).
limitations: Read via WebFetch extraction (small-model summary with quoted phrases), not a full manual read; quotes may be incomplete. Statement of intended use, not evidence of effects.

title: Freddie Mac Seller/Servicer Guide Section 5602.2 (Loan Collateral Advisor), as reproduced on homebuyer.com
authors_or_organization: Freddie Mac (Guide text); reproduced by Homebuyer.com
publication_date: Guide text undated on page; page published 2026-02-24
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Freddie Mac is interested party; reproduction by a commercial third-party site.
limitations: Secondary reproduction of Guide text read via WebFetch extraction; original Freddie Mac Guide not accessed (my.sf.freddiemac.com returned proxy 502). Shows contractual policy (relief eligibility), not effects.

title: Fannie Mae's 'Day 1 Certainty' Initiative Gives Lenders Greater Certainty and Efficiency on Appraisals (press release) and related Selling Guide announcement SEL-2017-03
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Fannie Mae developed CU and is the consequence-bearing purchaser (interested party).
limitations: All fanniemae.com and singlefamily.fanniemae.com pages returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare challenge. Content known only from search-engine result summaries (not verbatim, not verified). Treat as unverified pointer.

title: Attribute (Mis)Reporting and Appraisal Bias (preliminary AEA 2021 version; published as 'Attribute misreporting and appraisal bias', Review of Finance 28(5):1663-1686, 2024)
authors_or_organization: Michael D. Eriksen, Chun Kuang, Wenyu Zhu
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Data obtained with assistance of secondary-market-institution staff (acknowledgments); no commercial funding reported in preliminary version.
limitations: Read the preliminary version; published version not accessed (search summary says headline delinquency estimate changed to 9.8%; unverified). Data from one secondary-market institution, conforming loans only, stable market period. Observational.

title: Home Purchase Appraisals in Minority Neighborhoods, FHFA Staff Working Paper 24-06
authors_or_organization: Daniel Grodzicki, Sean Cannon, Christopher W. Davis, Ken Lam (FHFA)
data_collection_dates: UAD purchase appraisals (period per paper; not extracted)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: FHFA staff; views not official FHFA position.
limitations: Topic is appraisal bias, not review effort; used here only for (a) what standardized UAD data enables and (b) the local-information mechanism. Preliminary working paper; observational with IV.

title: Lowering Credit Risk: The Case for ACE (Capital Market Insights research note)
authors_or_organization: Kadiri Karamon and Doug McManus (Freddie Mac)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Authored by Freddie Mac, which operates ACE (interested party).
limitations: GSE self-evaluation; selection into ACE on unpublished criteria; authors' IV estimate is imprecise and not statistically different from zero. Results specific to ACE decision logic and a low-default period.

title: Residential Appraisals: Opportunities to Enhance Oversight of an Evolving Industry, GAO-11-653
limitations: Full report PDF/HTML returned Access Denied to scripted fetch; only the GAO product page summary read via WebFetch extraction. Reports participant concerns, not measured AMC effects; no share-of-AMC figure on product page.

title: The Texas Appraisers and Appraisal Management Company Survey (October 2012)
authors_or_organization: Texas A&M Real Estate Center; NORC at the University of Chicago; Hobby Center for Public Policy (for Texas Appraiser Licensing and Certification Board)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Commissioned by state licensing board (per hosting); no commercial sponsor identified.
limitations: Self-reported survey; one state; appraiser response rate 26%, AMC response rate 54% (per report); 2012 market. Stated perceptions about fees/quality, not measured quality.

title: The real impact of Fannie Mae's Collateral Underwriter
authors_or_organization: Chuck Mureddu (SVP and chief valuation officer, SWBC Lending Solutions) in HousingWire
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Author is an executive of an appraisal management/valuation services firm (interested party).
limitations: Anecdotal account from one AMC's client base, ~1 month after CU launch; read via WebFetch extraction. No data on magnitudes.

title: UAD and Forms Redesign FAQs
authors_or_organization: Freddie Mac (Uniform Mortgage Data Program, with Fannie Mae, at FHFA direction)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Freddie Mac is standard-setter and purchaser (interested party).
limitations: Official purpose statements, not effects. Read via WebFetch extraction.

title: 40 CFR 312.21 Results of inquiry by an environmental professional (All Appropriate Inquiries rule; ASTM E1527 is the recognized practice standard)
authors_or_organization: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (Code of Federal Regulations, 2024 edition)
limitations: Shows a regulatory content requirement (opinion, data gaps and their significance), not compliance, user review effort, or effects. ASTM E1527-21 itself (paywalled) not accessed.

title: Phase I environmental site assessments: what lenders require (NYREJ Long Island section column)
authors_or_organization: Chuck Merritt, President, Merritt Environmental Consulting Corp.
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Author runs a Phase I consulting firm (interested party).
limitations: Single practitioner's description; read via WebFetch extraction; title paraphrased (exact headline not captured).
